title: Project gate
responsibility: Offers the initial choice of a local project or a project on a connected computer.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.available
inputs.description: Whether local folder opening is available; together with busy it controls the local Open Project button, and while local is true it selects the local-project or read-only browser-preview hint and, when true, renders the GameCreate component. It never disables recent-project choices, which depend only on busy.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.local
inputs.description: Whether projects can be opened from this device; it defaults to true. False is for a phone, whose projects are those of a computer: it hides the Open Project button and the GameCreate component, makes the hint describe projects of a connected computer, and labels non-shared recent projects without a root On your computer.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.busy
inputs.description: Whether a project operation is in progress. While it is true, the local Open Project button (rendered only when local is true) is disabled, has aria-busy set and reads Opening project…, and every recent-project button is disabled.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.open
inputs.description: Required callback run when the local Open Project button is clicked; that button is rendered only while local is true and is enabled only while available is true and busy is false. The component does not choose a folder itself or catch callback failures.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.projects
inputs.description: Optional recent-project choices, defaulting to []; each supplies id, name, kind ('local' or 'shared') and optional root. Shared entries are labeled Shared project, and other entries show their root or else their device location (On this device, or On your computer when local is false).

inputs.name: ProjectGate.choose
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving a selected recent-project identifier. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted); activating a listed project does nothing when no callback is supplied.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.children
inputs.description: Optional additional content (a Svelte snippet) rendered last, after the recent-projects section. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), in which case nothing is rendered.

outputs.name: ProjectGate
outputs.description: Welcome markup: the brand mark, the Harness heading and tagline, the Open Project button when local is true (disabled while available is false or busy is true), a hint line, the GameCreate component when available and local are true, a Recent projects list when projects is non-empty (its buttons disabled while busy is true), then the children snippet. The hint is 'Choose a local Git project to begin.' when local and available are true, 'Browser preview · read-only. Open the desktop app to choose a local project.' when local is true and available is false, 'Choose a project of your computer.' when local is false and projects is non-empty, and 'The projects of your computer appear here once this phone is connected.' when local is false and projects is empty.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Errors thrown by the supplied open and choose callbacks, or by the children snippet, propagate unhandled when the callback is invoked or the snippet is rendered; this component provides no error boundary.
